text: Double-click on Enter Settlement (73,476) with two back-to-back pt click calls (~0.8 s wall apart): first entered (tick 982), second landed on Withdraw Funds, which took Enter Settlement's exact slot, withdrawing 6 coins (tick 1006). The 0.5 s settle had elapsed by the second click.

Craft Axe double-click (~0.45 s between presses, mousehold/wait 0.3/mousehold): crafted one axe (tick 7990); Craft Pickaxe slid left under the cursor but was drawn greyed and swallowed the second click. Protected as intended (see shots/dbl_craft.png).

Enter Settlement repeat-click threshold: press intervals 557/673/767 ms were swallowed (buttons drawn grey), 967 ms (and 800 ms earlier with two pt click calls) landed on Withdraw Funds, which appears in Enter Settlement's exact slot and is unconfirmed: 'Withdrew 22 coins from settlement' tick 9402. The 0.5 s wait handles a real double-click but not a slow second click.

Slow double-click on Exit Settlement at (355,476), ~0.95 s between presses: first exited (tick 11518); second landed on Plant Sapling, which occupies that spot on the outside bar, and silently planted my only sapling (Saplings 1 -> 0, no status message; banner still reads 'Exited settlement.').
